nonBlockingIssues.description: Navigation uses emoji characters as icons. Consider SVG icons with aria-hidden for better accessibility.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Replace emoji icons with SVG icons in a future iteration.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Clickable table rows have tabIndex={0} but lack role='button' for screen reader semantics.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Add role='button' to clickable table rows.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Pagination page indicator is not an ARIA live region.
KNOWN_TYPES array is currently empty, meaning the type filter dropdown only shows 'All types' option.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Consider populating KNOWN_TYPES with known type IDs or documenting how users can discover types via URL params.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Local truncateEntityId functions in triples-panel.tsx and relations-panel.tsx duplicate TruncateId component logic with different default lengths.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Consider consolidating or documenting the intentional difference.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Consider adding explicit guidance that when a feature cannot be completed within mission boundaries, workers MUST return to orchestrator rather than modifying off-limits packages.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: entities-page worker modified packages/api despite AGENTS.md explicitly forbidding it. The boundary is documented but the worker proceeded anyway.
